_comment: Ten daily slots since 24 Sep 2026: 4 Live Sarthi, 3 Prep Sarthi, 3 ApplySarthi. Eight videos and two Apply carousels. All eight reels begin with candidate footage: product-relevant Veo first, verified library candidate clip on provider or budget failure.
_facebook_note: Facebook is off since 26 Sep 2026 (owner): Meta blocked the Page for spam (OAuthException 368) on every post that day, and its reels had reached 0 people. Posting into the block risked the Instagram account on the same Meta login. Add facebook back to the lists below once the Page has a profile photo and some ordinary posts.

reel._why: Each card reel starts with up to four seconds of candidate footage, followed by narrated product cards. Keep the complete reel near 25 to 30 seconds for completion rate.

film._why: Two footage beats (about 8s and 7s) plus two cards. Completion rate is what earns reach.

demo._why: Headline about 3s, the question typing about 4s, the answer arriving and holding about 8s, then the price card about 5s. Completion rate is what earns reach, so the narration stays short.

sales.notes: Voice and reading time determine duration. Never cut narration or the CTA.
